default_options.description: List of default command-line options for k2pdfopt. These are prepended to all commands. See man page for specific flag meanings (e.g., -ac for auto-crop, -s for sharpen).

input_file.description: Path to the source PDF or DJVU file to be processed.

output_name_format.description: Output file name format string for the -o option. %s is replaced by the source filename. See man page -o section for details.

device_profile.description: Device profile for the -dev option (e.g., kindle2, kindle_pw3, kobo_clara). Determines default DPI and dimensions.

output_dpi.description: Output DPI for the -odpi option. Default is 167.

output_width.description: Output width in pixels for the -w option. Default is 560, but often overridden by device profile.

output_height.description: Output height in pixels for the -h option. Default is 735, but often overridden by device profile.

crop_margins.description: Crop margins in inches for the -m option, formatted as left,top,right,bottom. Default is 0.25 inches on all sides.

vertical_break_threshold.description: Vertical break threshold for the -vb option. Default is 1.75.

num_columns.description: Number of columns for the -col option. Default is 2.

text_wrapping.description: Enable text wrapping. Corresponds to -wrap if true, -wrap- if false.

native_output.description: Enable native PDF output. Corresponds to -n if true, -n- if false. Note: Disables OCR and wrapping.

ocr_enabled.description: Enable OCR. Corresponds to -ocr if true, -ocr- if false. Note: Disables native PDF output.

ocr_language.description: OCR language for the -ocrlang option. e.g., eng, fra, chi_sim.
